title: Cargo Inspector

reward.description: A heavy brass stamp that reads REJECTED on one side and APPROVED on the other. It has never been wrong.

hints: float("12.5") works, but float("heavy") raises ValueError. Use .strip() and check .endswith("kg") first.
In total_weight, wrap the call to parse_weight in try / except ValueError, and count the failures in the except block.
For lookup_berth, try returning berths[ship] and catch KeyError. For split_load, catch ZeroDivisionError.
